turns.assessment: The fault is isolated to svc117 at the ODU/client layer: both endpoints simultaneously report CLIENT_SF and ODU_TIM, while optical telemetry across its lightpaths is unchanged and many unprotected services sharing the same route remain healthy. ODU_TIM strongly favors a service-specific cross-connect misconnection over an optical fault or client-port failure. The evidence does not identify which OTN switch on the path contains the bad cross-connect, so a repair cannot be safely localized.

proposals.rationale: A wrong ODU cross-connect can affect only svc117, produce trace-identifier mismatch at the endpoints, and leave all optical measurements and neighboring services unchanged. The simultaneous ODU_TIM alarms are particularly diagnostic.
A failed endpoint client port could isolate this service and propagate failure indications, but it is less consistent with simultaneous ODU_TIM at both endpoints than an ODU misroute.
An OTN switch lies at the correct layer, but a fabric failure should interrupt every ODU through that switch; the many healthy neighboring services argue strongly against it.

score.why: truth not in the reported set
